en: A black and white historical postcard depicting a large building with two prominent towers at the entrance, flanked by a crowd of people gathered outside. The building appears to be an exhibition or convention hall. The architectural style and the crowd's attire suggest an early 20th-century European setting. The cityscape in the background features multi-story buildings and church spires, indicating an urban European environment. There is faint, handwritten text at the top of the postcard.
